nativeOracle.comparisonImplementation: Installed pinned Lean shared library, called directly by the native oracle

guardedRuns.provenance: The updated 65-case native run and focused JVM results were retained in the agent tool stdout. The scratch memory.json was overwritten by the later focused run; these are the updated native metrics, not those from the earlier 55-case oracle.

limitations: Differential coverage is the listed synthetic matrix, not a proof for every expression.
Collision caches exercise structural fallbacks; no general compatibility claim is made for arbitrarily forged inconsistent computed fields.
Pinned same-kind metadata Int/Syntax ordering returns false in both directions; this behavior is preserved.
Native heartbeat charging inside expression comparison is not modeled.
Memory figures are sampled observations; the very brief native oracle's sampled RSS is not an upper bound on its actual peak.
This is correctness validation, not a timing or competitive performance benchmark.
This measurement does not establish completion of the ordinary-file probe.
